# `marker.place`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/marker.place.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`marker.place` (`PlaceMarker`, WP-S2.04 §5.1; FR-CON-023, FR-CON-039): places the group wire marker of several
connections of one page. One transaction: on each connection `overrides.show_marker` becomes true,
`overrides.csa` becomes `csa` when given and `overrides.colour` becomes `colours[i]` when given; then a page item
`{"wire_marker": {connections, at, angle, fields: ["csa", "colour"]}}` lists the connections in the given (printed)
order. The marker displays the connections' effective values; it stores none of its own (doc 08 §4.5). Nothing
derived is read. Rejected: no connection, or one listed twice (at `/connections`); a connection that does not
exist (not found) or is not drawn on `page` (at `/connections/<i>`); an angle other than 0 or 90000 (at
`/angle`); `colours` neither empty nor one per connection (at `/colours`); a colour that is neither an IEC 60757
code nor a company code of the project's colour profile (at `/colours/<i>`, FR-CON-019); a missing page (not
found). Interactive. Outcome: the marker.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `angle` | [`CmdAngle2`](#cmdangle2) | no |  | The angle in 10⁻³ degree: 0 or 90000; default 0. |
| `at` | [`CmdPt2`](#cmdpt2) | yes |  | The anchor point of the group. |
| `colours` | array of [`ColourSpec`](#colourspec) | no |  | The colours to set: empty, or one per connection in order (their level-7 overrides). |
| `connections` | array of [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The connections in printed order: at least one, distinct, all drawn on `page`. |
| `csa` | [`Csa`](#csa) or `null` | no |  | A cross-section to set on every connection (its level-7 override). |
| `page` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The page. |

## Types

### CmdAngle2

An angle in 10^-3 degree, counter-clockwise on the sheet (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: integer (min -2147483648, max 2147483647)

### CmdPt2

A point or a displacement [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### ColourSpec

One or two colour codes (doc 03 §3.4).

Type: array of [`ColourCode`](#colourcode) (at least 1 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### ColourCode

An IEC 60757 or profile-declared company colour code, or {"foreign": code} (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Ident`](#ident)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: object { `foreign`: [`Ident`](#ident) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `foreign` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text. |

### Csa

A cross-section: a Dec3 string in mm², {"awg": n} or {"kcmil": Dec3} (doc 08 §4.6).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Dec3`](#dec3)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: object { `awg`: integer (min -128, max 127) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `awg` | integer (min -128, max 127) | yes |  |  |

3. **Form 3**

   Shape: object { `kcmil`: [`Dec3`](#dec3) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `kcmil` | [`Dec3`](#dec3) | yes |  | A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader. |

### Dec3

A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Type: string (at most 21 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,15}(?:\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])?|-?0\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])$`

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
